sources: Coach record: every men's Test, ODI and T20I India played from 27 July 2024 (Gambhir's first match in charge) in the Cricsheet archive (cricsheet.org): 21 Tests, 26 ODIs, 68 T20Is. Matches abandoned without a ball bowled are not in the archive; super-over ties are counted as wins for the winner. Other reports quote slightly different totals for the same period; headline results were checked against Wikipedia's account of his tenure.

Series results: Bangladesh 2-0, New Zealand 0-3, Australia 1-3, England 2-2, West Indies 2-0, South Africa 0-2, Sri Lanka 1-0 (Tests, from the same archive). Champions Trophy 2025: five wins from five; T20 World Cup 2026 and Asia Cup 2025 won (ICC / Wikipedia).

Player career figures (Tests 58, ODIs 147, T20Is 37; averages 41.95, 39.68, 27.41; finals 75 off 54 in 2007 and 97 off 122 in 2011; two IPL titles as KKR captain, 2012 and 2014): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gautam_Gambhir

Gambhir's strike rates (T20I 119 from 34 of 37 innings; ODI 86 from 134 innings) are from our Cricsheet archive, a sample, not career totals. IPL 2013-2017: Sportmonks ball-by-ball cache (runs off the bat per 100 legal balls; league = all batters that season; super overs excluded). India's strike rates under him are runs per 100 legal balls in the same archive. Figures: make_gambhir.py.

long.vo: Four ICC trophies. Two as a player: the two thousand seven T-twenty World Cup, and the twenty eleven World Cup. Two as India's head coach: the twenty twenty-five Champions Trophy, and the twenty twenty-six T-twenty World Cup. So who was better, गौतम गंभीर the player, or गौतम गंभीर the coach?

scene.title: Four ICC trophies.
scene.label: two as a player, two as India's head coach

long.vo: This is a Data Story. We will put the player's numbers next to the coach's results, one at a time, and see what each tells us.

The player first. He was a big-match batter. In the two thousand seven T-twenty World Cup final against Pakistan, seventy-five off fifty-four balls. In the twenty eleven World Cup final, ninety-seven off a hundred and twenty-two.

scene.kicker: GAUTAM GAMBHIR · THE PLAYER · WORLD CUP FINALS
scene.title: Two finals, two big innings.

long.vo: Across his career, he was an opener of real quality. Fifty-eight Tests: four thousand, one hundred and fifty-four runs at forty-two, with nine hundreds. A hundred and forty-seven one-day internationals: five thousand, two hundred and thirty-eight runs at nearly forty, with eleven hundreds. In T-twenty internationals, thirty-seven matches at twenty-seven.

scene.kicker: GAUTAM GAMBHIR · THE PLAYER · CAREER BATTING AVERAGE
scene.title: A Test and one-day opener.

long.vo: In the IPL, he captained कोलकाता Knight Riders to two titles, in twenty twelve and twenty fourteen.

But his T-twenty batting was patient. In the IPL, from twenty thirteen to twenty seventeen, he scored two thousand and sixty-eight runs. And his strike rate was below the league's in every one of those five seasons, by as much as fifteen points.

scene.kicker: GAMBHIR'S IPL STRIKE RATE VS THE LEAGUE'S · SPORTMONKS
scene.title: Below the league, every year.

long.vo: In T-twenty internationals, in our archive of thirty-four of his thirty-seven innings, he struck at one nineteen. And in one-day internationals, at eighty-six. A patient opener, by modern standards.

scene.kicker: THE PLAYER · T20I STRIKE RATE · OUR ARCHIVE
scene.title: A patient opener.
scene.label: 34 of his 37 T20I innings, 918 runs · ODIs: 86

long.vo: Now, the coach. In July twenty twenty-four, गौतम गंभीर became India's head coach. His first match in charge was a T-twenty international in Sri Lanka, at the end of July. Since then, in our archive, India have played a hundred and fifteen men's internationals under him.

Here is the record. In Tests: eight wins, ten losses and three draws. In one-day internationals: fifteen wins, ten losses and a tie. In T-twenty internationals: forty-eight wins, sixteen losses and four no-results. That is a win rate of thirty-eight per cent in Tests, fifty-eight per cent in one-day cricket, and seventy-one per cent in T-twenty.

scene.kicker: INDIA UNDER GAMBHIR · WIN RATE BY FORMAT · SINCE 27 JULY 2024
scene.title: Strong in white ball. Not in Tests.

long.vo: And the trophies came. The Champions Trophy in twenty twenty-five, unbeaten: five matches, five wins. The Asia Cup in twenty twenty-five, beating Pakistan in the final. And the twenty twenty-six T-twenty World Cup. As कोलकाता Knight Riders' mentor, he had also won the IPL in twenty twenty-four.

But Tests are where it has hurt. Seven Test series under him. Three wins: Bangladesh, West Indies and Sri Lanka. One draw: two-all in England. And three defeats: New Zealand three-nil, Australia three-one, and South Africa two-nil.

scene.kicker: TEST SERIES UNDER GAMBHIR · INDIA'S MARGIN
scene.title: Three wins, one draw, three defeats.

long.vo: Two of those defeats came at home: three-nil against New Zealand, and two-nil against South Africa.

scene.kicker: TEST SERIES LOST AT HOME UNDER GAMBHIR
scene.title: Two home defeats.
scene.label: 0-3 v New Zealand (2024) · 0-2 v South Africa (2025)

long.vo: Now compare the styles. As a player, in our archive, his strike rate was one nineteen in T-twenty, and eighty-six in one-day cricket. India under him strike at one sixty-seven and one hundred and three. The patient opener now coaches a team that scores much faster than he ever did.

So, player or coach? As a player, he delivered in the biggest finals. As a coach, India's white-ball results are strong: three trophies, and a winning record in both limited-overs formats. But in Tests, eight wins from twenty-one is the weak spot. The player was patient. His team is not. And Test cricket is where that gap shows.
Is गौतम गंभीर a better player or a better coach? Tell us in the comments, and follow for more Data Stories.

short.vo: As a player, गौतम गंभीर struck at about one nineteen in T-twenty cricket. The India team he coaches strikes at one sixty-seven. Player or coach: who wins?
As a player, he won two World Cup finals: seventy-five off fifty-four in two thousand seven, and ninety-seven in the twenty eleven final.
As a coach, India won the Champions Trophy unbeaten, the Asia Cup, and the twenty twenty-six T-twenty World Cup.
In T-twenty, India have won forty-eight of sixty-eight. In one-day cricket, fifteen of twenty-six.
But in Tests: twenty-one matches, eight wins, ten losses. Including two home series defeats.
So, trophies in white ball. Tests still to solve. The patient player now coaches a very fast team.
